nodes.label: Human-Approved-Only Indexing Rule

nodes.label: Vendor Scoring Isolation Rationale
nodes.rationale: Scoring runs one vendor at a time in isolation — a vendor must never see another vendor's submission. Ranking is a separate aggregation step that only sees scores, not raw submissions.

nodes.rationale: Nothing is ever published, activated, or awarded by the AI directly. The approval step is always a human action gated in the backend — this is the single rule connecting all three agents.
